instruction: Open Visual Studio Code and create a Python script named `mnist_pca_reconstruction.py` under `/home/user/analysis_results/`. In this script: (1) Use the `openml` library to fetch the MNIST_784 dataset (OpenML ID 554). (2) Convert the data into a NumPy array `X` of shape (n_samples, 784). (3) Standardize it and perform PCA with 10, 50, and 100 components separately. (4) For each model, reconstruct the original data using `inverse_transform` and compute the mean-squared-error (MSE) between original and reconstructed features. (5) Save a text file named `mnist_pca_reconstruction_summary.json` in the same directory containing exactly one JSON line: `{ "mse_10": <value>, "mse_50": <value>, "mse_100": <value> }` with numeric values rounded to 4 decimals.
